requirements.title: Supplied key is not identity proof
HMAC secret is verifier capability only
Candidate match does not rewrite historical disclosure
Caller policy does not change historical evidence
Malformed Receipt does not erase independent results
Receipt identity is not payload digest
Repeated Presentation is not new Receipt
Unpinned resolution is not exact payload binding
Pinned resolution requires target digest match
Pin match does not prove target signature/truth
Cross-Receipt graph checks use resolved material
Derivation acyclicity is global over resolved graph
ReceiptLink acyclicity is global over resolved links
Whole commitment does not prove hidden sublocation
Redacted derivative does not verify hidden original binding
Hash match is not confidentiality proof
HMAC secrets are not report content
HMAC tag presence is not candidate verification
Digest match is bounded commitment evidence
Baseline Signing Statement uses JCS UTF-8 bytes
Unresolved key differs from invalid signature
Unsupported signature profile differs from invalid
Signature validity is not key trust
Signature verification differs from supplied-ARP binding
Valid signature is not record truth
Invalid signature is not universal factual falsehood
Signature count is not truth voting
Record existence differs from external fact
Tool success is not Effect truth
Non-completed execution is not no-effect proof
Evidence count does not create truth
Temporal proximity and reachability are not causality
Contradictory external evidence is preserved as conflict
Reference closure is not history completeness
Timestamp is not generic conflict precedence
Signature count is not conflict precedence
Unsupported profile is not silently downgraded
Malformed supported profile is invalid, not unsupported
Profile identifiers do not execute code
Fully resolved supplied set is not global history
Finding identifies check, subject, domain, status
Private evidence need not be echoed
Keyed secrets never appear in ordinary report
Candidate plaintext is not automatically echoed
Human output cannot strengthen machine findings
asserted cannot render as proved truth
Exit zero cannot mean all facts true
Resource limits do not rewrite claims
Untrusted metadata does not authorize I/O
Provider receipt remains unestablished by adapter evidence
Remote tool receipt/commit remains unestablished by client evidence
Valid linkage does not complete history
Schema validation does not replace semantic verification
Schema failure is structural invalidity when applicable
Unsupported extension does not erase independently verifiable integrity
Unknown extension is not silently interpreted
Unsigned Receipt is not invalid solely for signature absence
Signature absence is distinct from unverified/invalid
Key verification success does not resolve unrelated key ambiguity
VerificationReport declares invocation goals and capability summary
Mandatory checks cannot disappear from machine report
Resolver material is content-bound for reproducibility
Trusted-time claim requires recognized time evidence
Invalidity and incompleteness can coexist in findings
Process outcome aggregation precedence is deterministic
Process outcome never hides detailed findings
Unsupported optional extension does not force incomplete mandatory baseline
unresolved prerequisites prevent positive consistency when required
Conflict can coexist with structural invalidity
Conflict alone is not universal invalidity
